item.title: Pantograph 1.1.11
item.description:
New

  • A smoother move between photos. Going to the next or previous file now glides the new picture in from that side while the old one fades away, in about a fifth of a second, instead of flashing an arrow. With Reduce Motion on, it's a simple crossfade.

Fixed

  • The Adjust panel stays sharp when you're zoomed in. The live preview used a screen-sized copy of the whole photo, which looked soft until you pressed Apply. Now what's on screen is previewed at full resolution.

If you have Pantograph 1.1.3 or later, it will offer this update by itself (1.1.7 and later install it quietly when you quit). Otherwise, download Pantograph-1.1.11.zip, unzip it and drag Pantograph to Applications. Requires macOS 13 or later; runs natively on Apple silicon and Intel. Signed and notarized by Apple.
